question.text: Do multimodal signal combinations and ordered signal sequences in wild chimpanzees predict recipient responses and communicative outcomes beyond what is explained by component signals, context, and recipient state alone?
question.primary_discriminator: Out-of-sample improvement in predicting recipient response/outcome when combination/sequence features are added beyond component-signal + context + identity baselines, with replication across individuals/populations.
question.ethics_boundary: Passive/archive-data synthesis initially. Any new animal-facing playback or manipulation remains blocked by the canonical ethics/welfare gate.
